name: canvas-lms
description: Your Canvas courses in Claude: grades, deadlines, assignments, messages and study plans.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to your school's Canvas LMS with 240 student tools: what's due this week, your grades and what you need on the rest, assignment instructions and rubrics, announcements and messages, course files (PDF, Word, PowerPoint), a daily briefing, study plans and calendar export. Anything that posts, submits or sends goes through a confirmation step first. Your token stays on this computer and is only sent to your school's Canvas.

canvas_url.title: Your school's Canvas address
canvas_url.description: The address you see in your browser in Canvas, for example https://yourschool.instructure.com

canvas_token.title: Canvas access token
canvas_token.description: In Canvas: Account > Settings > Approved Integrations > + New Access Token. Copy the token and paste it here.

allow_writes.title: Allow submitting, posting and sending
allow_writes.description: Lets Claude submit work, post in discussions and send messages, after a confirmation step. Turn off for read-only.

profile.title: Which tools to turn on
profile.description: full (every tool), or a smaller set: essentials, core, study, grades or readonly. A number from 1 to 6 works too. Fewer tools can help Claude pick the right one.
